purpose: Deferred folder deletion used during uninstall; spawns a child process that waits for the parent to exit before recursively deleting the target folder.
calls_out_to: Process.GetProcessById / WaitForExit — waits for parent to terminate
invariants: IsSafeDeleteTarget refuses any path that equals the filesystem root (prevents deleting C:\)
Up to 12 retry attempts with 500ms delays; ClearReadOnlyAttributes is called before each attempt
gotchas: The cleanup child process IS the same exe re-invoked with --cleanup-folder args; Program.cs checks for these flags first and exits immediately after cleanup
Falls back to in-process deletion if child process cannot be started — this may silently fail if the folder is locked by the exiting parent
Path.GetFullPath is called on the folder argument; malformed paths silently return empty string and are skipped
